title: Ohio RFC 0720 AM Forecast: Mill Street Crest 10.8 ft Near 10:30

fields.office: NWS Ohio River Forecast Center Wilmington OH
fields.headline: ...EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE... SUGAR CAMP RUN AT THE MILL STREET CULVERT FORECAST TO CREST NEAR 10.8 FEET AROUND 1030 AM THURSDAY... CREST RAISED 2.3 FEET AND MOVED ABOUT 3 HOURS EARLIER...
areas: Sugar Camp Run at the Mill Street culvert, Marlowe OH (MSU stage gauge)
discussion: EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE. Heavy rain is falling over the Sugar Camp Run basin north of Marlowe. Observed rainfall rates since 600 AM have been well above the rates used in the previous forecast. The MSU stage gauge at the Mill Street culvert read 7.0 ft at 720 AM EDT and is rising about 1.7 ft per hour.

This forecast includes QPF of 1.5 to 2 inches through 10 AM. The forecast calls for 8.0 ft near 8 AM, 9.5 ft near 9 AM and 10.5 ft near 10 AM. The crest is 10.8 ft near 1030 AM Thursday. After that the creek falls slowly through the afternoon as rainfall rates ease.

Changes since the previous issuance (540 AM EDT): The crest was raised 2.3 ft, from 8.5 ft to 10.8 ft. Crest timing moved about 3 hours earlier, from near 130 PM to near 1030 AM, because observed rainfall rates were higher. Any decision based on the 540 AM forecast should be reviewed against this issuance.

Uncertainty: Rainfall after 10 AM or a debris blockage at the culvert trash rack could raise local stages above this forecast or keep them high for longer. The forecast does not account for a culvert blockage. Stages near 12.0 ft are not forecast at this time but cannot be ruled out if heavier rain continues past 10 AM. EXERCISE EXERCISE EXERCISE

fields.impacts: Impacts from this point's stage list: at 8.0 ft, water covers the Dairy Lane crossing. At 9.0 ft, the Lower Quad floods and pedestrian paths are under water. At 9.5 ft, Parking Lot C floods. At 10.5 ft, water reaches the Riverside Hall basement, including the mechanical room, laundry, transformer vault and main electrical gear. At 12.0 ft, not forecast at this time, the Whitcomb Library lower level floods.
fields.nextUpdate: The next issuance will be by 900 AM EDT Thu Mar 25 2027, or sooner if conditions warrant.

instructorNote: This is the central decision inject. The forecast crest is above 10.5 ft within 3 hours, so EOP Annex F section 5 triggers the Riverside evacuation order. Working back from 10:00 with the sweep's clearance time and a margin puts the decision near 08:00. Watch for these: the IC logs that deadline and names the 0720 AM issuance as the basis, the IC weighs Level 1, Facilities moves Lot C now (8.5 ft comes near 08:30), and the DoS readies Kessler Fieldhouse. At the same moment, the TA hands the control-table note to the Student Evaluators. It tells them to start a third clock at 1:55 (07:25), check whether each decision-log entry cites the 0720 AM crest forecast, quote word for word anything any seat says about Riverside, and not prompt any seat.
